public.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
public.description: Two ascending integer arrays have at least one total element. Return TWICE their mathematical median so the output remains an integer. For an odd total return twice the middle value; for an even total return the sum of the two middle values. Total length is 1 to 1000; values between -1000000 and 1000000.
hints: Merge the arrays and locate the middle position or positions.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: The direct reference merges in O(m+n) time and space, then computes the doubled median exactly.
